implementationStages: validate audit findings against current code and authorized behavior
finish durable optimistic completion and fix contract checks
fix reproducible authentication storage synchronization and editing defects
implement catalog and adaptive personal scheduling without changing shared authority
implement MET regional weather cache and provider
measure and fix startup and interaction performance
run required regressions cloud attacks and both mobile platforms

findings.title: O01｜通知集計で日付ごとの全走査と家事名の線形検索を繰り返す
findings.resolution: Index only window-start/end/next-day reminder boundaries, group history by chore once and resolve names by map. A thousand old rows no longer require 31 whole-schedule scans; digest outputs stay identical.

findings.title: O02｜SecureStoreのhex表現と大量のネイティブ呼び出し
findings.resolution: Base64 writes reduce protected chunk volume by about one third; legacy hex remains readable, native chunk concurrency limited to four.

findings.title: O03｜解析状況の取得ごとに利用回数の同期トランザクションが走る
findings.resolution: Steady status polling uses read-only quota evidence. Changed bindings/refunds still synchronize the strict counters transactionally.

findings.title: O04｜CIの共通検査を各プラットフォームで重複実行している
findings.resolution: Keep both OS behavior test matrices and existing job names, but run platform-independent lint/typecheck once. npm pretest remains the required contract gate.

findings.title: O05｜Firestoreエミュレーターの再ダウンロード
findings.resolution: CI caches only the pinned Firestore emulator JAR, never database state or credentials. Local CLI/Firestore versions verified; GitHub execution remains unobserved for unpushed edits.

findings.title: O06｜明らかに不正な購入入力でDB世代を更新しない
findings.resolution: Reject malformed purchase evidence before durable verification generation changes.

findings.title: O07｜要求ごとのレート制限Map全走査を必要な時だけにする
findings.resolution: One bounded fixed-window limiter serves both HTTP paths, evicts expiry prefixes only, and retains identity limits across server-clock rollback.

findings.title: O08｜家事単位の履歴読取りと索引を対応させる
findings.resolution: Migration creates an index matching household/chore completion reads; query-plan regression confirms it is used.

findings.title: O09｜処理済み操作の記録を安全に維持し、増加と繰返しDDLを管理する
findings.resolution: Completion intent markers are created during migration and kept for replay safety, without per-completion DDL.

findings.title: O10｜Tasksの全履歴取得を毎回繰り返す構成を見直す
findings.resolution: Schema26 adds account/list-isolated durable page staging and a complete Tasks cache in both real private and v2 stores. Use updatedMin deltas only after a complete baseline, with Google response time minus5s; missing server time forces full traversal. 7-day/backward-clock full checks, expired/repeated cursor recovery, scoped corrupt-cache rebuild and 10000-task/2-change regression passed. Cached full-list reconciliation CPU/memory remains an optimization opportunity.

findings.title: O11｜Tasksの同期全体に処理予算と中断位置を持たせる
findings.resolution: The existing queue, credentials, all HTTP pages and response bodies share a caller budget. Normal/completion/worker15s and default forced manual100s. Actual late work stays fenced/coalesced until cleanup. Each committed receive page resumes after restart; incomplete traversal cannot reconcile deletion. Interrupted SQLite transactions are not forcibly cancelled, and OS rescheduling is not guaranteed. Physical final-run checks remain.

findings.title: O12｜承認画面を開くたびに過去の招待を全件取得してから捨てる
findings.resolution: Open-invitation queries freeze the current time and use snapshot pagination instead of retrieving historical invitations. The production composite groupId/status/expiresAt index is READY. All five pre-existing field overrides preserved; five additional prepared large encrypted/cache fields excluded from indexing. Readback matches configured fields plus automatic provider defaults. An empty synthetic-group read-only query with the exact production filters/order succeeded; this is index acceptance, not a real-user invitation UI pass.

findings.title: O13｜復旧の概要画面を開くために、保存原文を1件ずつ全て復元する
findings.resolution: Recovery overview reads only summary metadata and preserved facts, not original ciphertext. Confirmation still validates every original in bounded 100-ID SQL batches. 201-original ordering, altered evidence and both OS UI regressions pass.

findings.title: O14｜同じ権限履歴を、端末同期と取得元の確認で重複取得・再検証する
findings.resolution: Keep the full already-verified immutable signed prefix in process memory, fetch only a fresh head and signed suffix in later cycles, and reuse a verified history only inside the same bounded AbortSignal work scope. Pending commits invalidate work reuse before receipt recovery; account/root/generation/pin mismatches, regressed heads, gaps and aborts still reject. 105-revision multi-page, account-switch, altered head and lost-receipt regressions passed.

findings.title: O15｜個人Calendarの二つの予定源を最大値で合成する近似を、用途に合わせて見直す
findings.resolution: Active personal adaptive planning combines exact application/Google intervals by union. Fully received account-bound Google mirrors are verified from all calendar cursors, pending inbox/expansions and actual expanded coverage, not a requested display range. Incomplete or unavailable mirrors cannot grant free time using primary-only FreeBusy zero. Aggregate-only nonzero days remain opaque; frozen legacy engines are unchanged.

findings.title: O16｜Android受信処理内の同期DB操作を短くする
findings.resolution: Android broadcast uses goAsync and one background input executor. Queue insertion has bounded SQLite busy timeout and never updates completion/history/Google state. Release Kotlin compilation passed; physical interaction pending. Physical Android10 validates the corrected native SQL API and queue-only writes. No actual home-screen launch/tap timing claim. Actual normal v12 launcher row was tapped once: one widget completion fact/input receipt and no pending native input, then normal Home Undo restored0 completed facts without database edits. See widget-v12-android-before/after/after-undo logs. No immediate-render or background execution claim.

findings.title: O17｜「処理が例外なく戻った」と「同期が完了した」を区別する
findings.resolution: Runtime wrappers return structured outcomes. OS audit distinguishes disabled/skipped, received/no-change, pending key/review/busy/approval, and failed; pending is not incorrectly returned as OS failure. Metadata-only 32-row boundary remains.

findings.title: O18｜不正な受付IDを、PDF構造解析の後まで判定しない
findings.resolution: Invalid admission IDs are rejected after authentication but before body/PDF parsing; reservations still follow PDF inspection.

findings.title: O19｜ローカルPDFの検証だけなのに、共有送信用の全チャンクを生成して捨てる
findings.resolution: Local PDF saves and reads use full byte/digest validation without generating unused network chunks; shared transfers retain identical chunk validation.

findings.title: O20｜ネイティブ検証を、変更入力・有効な設定・生成後の成果物へ対応させる
findings.resolution: Native CI input paths now include app/widget source and Metro/Babel inputs; ordinary changes compile Android Kotlin instead of only manual dispatch. macOS CI compiles and executes the actual iOS journal across separate processes. These workflow changes have not been pushed or observed on GitHub.

findings.title: O21｜同じ候補日を複数の移動窓から繰り返し検査・整列する
findings.resolution: Select the best equivalent window per forecast day before weather/load/dependency checks. Same tie-breaks and existing 83 behavior regressions plus a bounded repeated-check case pass.

findings.title: O22｜収集のない日まで走査し、不要な月末計算を繰り返す
findings.resolution: Weekly/biweekly/monthly generators jump directly between collection dates. Differential tests cover clamps/leap years/anchors and a 31-year case avoids non-collection-day Date construction.

findings.title: O23｜一括初期化で変更がなくても予定キャッシュを無効にする
findings.resolution: A no-op all-chore reset neither writes schedule/definition rows nor advances the planner cache version. Atomic rollback behavior remains.

findings.title: O24｜下書きだけの更新でも保存済み予定全体を読み直す
findings.resolution: Draft-only observation reads only draft rows and keeps saved event/category/exception inputs. A saved-event change arriving during a slow draft read upgrades the queued read to full.

findings.title: O25｜日付ごとの予定検索を表示範囲単位で索引化する
findings.resolution: Calendar occurrence coverage is indexed once, replacing a complete event scan per day; multiday/midnight behavior compared across 3000 events.

findings.title: Q01｜未完了Promiseへの復旧方針は追加検証が必要runtimeの15秒タイマーが直接制限するのはboundedで囲った認証トークン取得・fetch・JSON読
findings.resolution: Tasks and FreeBusy fetch/body reads terminate even if native abort is ignored. Queue/credential/API budgets and late-result fences are tested. Page checkpoint transactions preserve progress; caller timeout does not claim that SQLite or OS background execution was forcibly stopped.

findings.title: Q02｜Googleの保留購入取消し時のexpiryTime欠落F08はPENDING_PURCHASE_CANCELEDをexpiredへ写像し、expiryTimeがなければ
findings.resolution: A canceled pending Google purchase without expiryTime already returns expired/0 and grants no access. Added regression also rejects wrong account and active records without expiry. No additional behavior change needed.

findings.title: Q03｜対応範囲より新しいDBバージョンを、そのまま受け入れるmigrations.tsのrunMigrationはuser_version >= CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSIONで成功終了
findings.resolution: Future SQLite schema versions are refused before connection/schema mutations; current schemas avoid repeated migration writes.

findings.title: Q04｜ネイティブの別接続経路を、単一接続の試験だけでは確認できない
findings.resolution: Independent file-backed Node WAL, Android JNI4 and separate empty-sandbox physical Android10/iPhone12 Release Hermes/Expo SQLite3.53.3 JS tests pass. Both OS6 cases verify data_version, concurrent read/write isolation, stale WAL rejection, readonly peer, application exclusive rollback and captured-owner final fence. Disposable DBs and newly owned test apps removed; normal app/data retained. iOS harness entry/scene/output issues retained as failed harness trials, not product passes. Test output JSX differs from earlier Android source pin; storage logic/6 assertions identical. No whole-app security or Firebase revocation proof.

findings.title: Q05｜TasksのDELETEに対する条件付き要求の実挙動TaskにETagがあることと、Tasksの性能ガイドが条件付き更新の考え方を説明することは公式本
findings.resolution: Physical Android10 same-signer provider-only probe used the existing native Tasks grant. A unique synthetic list/task was completed between GET and stale If-Match DELETE: actual HTTP412 and completion preservation. Fresh ETag DELETE204 and identity-checked synthetic-list cleanup both passed. No credentials or provider bodies left the device. tasks-conditional-live-android-v7.log. This proves provider enforcement, not R66 two-phone synchronization.

findings.title: Q06｜別のroster更新で古くなった復旧確認を中断できるか不具合としては保留。confirmInsideは状態の鮮度を確かめる前にmarkConfirmingを保存する。
findings.resolution: Reproduced with two independently persisted owner sessions through public recovery APIs and real Firestore, without administrative data edits: one pending confirmation was blocked after the other recovery advanced the roster. Verify the current signed snapshot/key/witnesses before locally cancelling an obsolete uncommitted review; recognize a matching lost-ACK commit as applied instead. Current cloud locks, accepted recovery and original evidence remain intact. Fresh reviews are not marked confirming before their full comparison succeeds.

findings.title: Q07｜許容サイズ内PDFのBase64検査で例外。ただし指定ランタイムの確認は未完了
findings.resolution: Full 6 MiB Base64 PDF reproduction overflowed the old grouped regex. Linear character validation plus canonical decode/encode now accepts the limit and rejects malformed encoding.

findings.title: Q08｜選択地域と端末のタイムゾーンが異なる場合の「同じ日」の意味
findings.resolution: The adopted MET provider preserves actual forecast instants instead of assigning daily summaries to another timezone. Independent Tokyo/Honolulu owner civil-day fixture proves the same Japanese forecast moves only the wet Tokyo slot, without changing dates or inventing a conversion. New regression passes. Actual provider deployment and physical weather checks remain separate pending work.

findings.title: Q09｜削除した実施回の復旧導線は製品仕様の
findings.resolution: Restoring Google-only deleted recurrence instances as a new UI action is an unadopted product proposal. The user rejected added confirmation operations; keep the proposal documented. Existing explicitly authorized resets and receipt-backed export recovery remain covered; unknown external histories stay held instead of being overwritten.

findings.title: Q10｜確認後に増えた例外まで全体リセットする契約の確認
findings.resolution: Series resets must match the exception IDs captured when reviewed; newly arrived exceptions are not silently cleared.

findings.title: Q11｜競合・受付待ちを除外した同期の「成功」をどう表示するか
findings.resolution: Private export inputs explicitly retain receipt/conflict blockers without a delete instruction. Eligible independent events still send, pending stays true and full-sync timestamp is not advanced while any source is blocked. Signed SQLite receipt/conflict/resolution tests and runtime tests pass; pending UI no longer promises an unresolved version will send on the next attempt.

findings.title: Q12｜Googleアカウントの明示的な再接続契約
findings.resolution: Ordinary ON/OFF and background sync remain bound to the saved Google subject. Existing connection-change action can explicitly prepare another native account even while OFF; returned calendar/account review, current subject and control CAS are verified before rebinding. Old account/target links remain private and reusable on return. Both OS callback tests and runtime tests passed; no real account was changed.

findings.title: Q13｜複数端末・Google側変更後の復旧方針S01の初期Google IDは利用者・グループ・Googleアカウント・追加先・元予定IDから決まる。
findings.resolution: Verified receipted historical series projections permit safe ETag adoption/rebase after another device export, including a lost rebase reply and a newer pending source without rollback. Unknown Google-only edits/deletions and individual-instance histories remain held; independent records continue. A new user overwrite/restore UI is not adopted. Actual-service/two-physical-device verification remains.

findings.title: R01｜共有スケジューラーの契約不一致でCIが停止
findings.resolution: Finished optimistic completion screen wiring and upgraded the formal contract to draft 48. Compatibility checks pass locally; whole-task release and physical-device verification remain pending.

findings.title: R02｜古い購入記録の照会失敗が有効な新規購入も止める
findings.resolution: Retire terminal Google refresh pointers while preserving permanent purchase ownership; recognize only documented terminal 410 responses.

findings.title: R03｜契約機能の初期化失敗後に再初期化できない
findings.resolution: Failed auth initialization releases its observer and can restart.

findings.title: R04｜秘密情報のチャンク削除失敗を成功扱いし、孤立データが残る
findings.resolution: Protected cleanup journal survives partial deletion and interrupted replacements; committed saves remain readable.

findings.title: R05｜購入承認の再試行を利用者の再接続だけに依存させない
findings.resolution: Google pending acknowledgements are persisted in the grant transaction and retried by a bounded leased server job. Restart, lost reply, concurrent workers and revoked-purchase regressions pass locally. Managed scheduling and real store tests await store/project setup.

findings.title: R06｜202応答後の解析をプロセス内だけで実行する
findings.resolution: Public HTTP admission now commits encrypted uploaded input and quota atomically and never starts post-response analysis. Independent worker uses recoverable pre-paid leases, an at-most-once paid-start fence, durable result settlement, exact quota refunds, recent worker heartbeat admission gate and redacted failure events. Dedicated AES-256-GCM keyring stays outside Firestore and fails closed when missing; no real key, worker scheduler, public native attestation or deployment configured.

findings.title: R07｜通知予約枠の省略を呼び出し元へ返していない
findings.resolution: Notification reconciliation returns counts for accepted/unchanged/cancelled, deadline, permission and capacity exclusions. A typed failure carries partial counts and the original cause. Shared reminders and daily digests preserve these results without adding banners or changing cross-scope authority.

findings.title: R08｜依存関係の警告とバックポートの有効性を分けて検査する
findings.resolution: Inventory and behavior tests cover every resolved installed glob/minimatch copy; API audit clean, root has 22 moderate version advisories and no high/critical. Backport testing is not an advisory withdrawal.

findings.title: R09｜検証と保存の間の競合で契約revisionが巻き戻る
findings.resolution: Serialize entitlement acceptance per account and refuse revision rollback.

findings.title: R10｜失効情報の保存失敗で古い利用許可が残る
findings.resolution: A verified denial locks immediately; failed protected writes retain denial in memory and attempt removal of the old grant. Total secure-storage failure remains an explicit durability limit.

findings.title: R11｜商品カタログの一時障害が新規購入を固定的に止める
findings.resolution: Retry product catalogue after recovery without dropping purchase observation or paid receipts.

findings.title: R12｜未来の端末時刻が保存され、時計修正後も契約がロックされる
findings.resolution: A verified fresh HTTPS response repairs future wall-clock poisoning; offline certificates cannot roll the trusted clock back.

findings.title: R13｜古い購入要求のcatchが別アカウントのbusyを解除する
findings.resolution: Bind purchase callbacks and UI updates to the exact login session, including A-B-A switches.

findings.title: R14｜AppleのTEST通知を正規の疎通確認として受理できない
findings.resolution: Verified Apple TEST notification accepts an omitted transaction; application and environment checks remain mandatory.

findings.title: R15｜取消し後の再完了で、取り消した実施日が状態に復活する
findings.resolution: Immutable completion/undo actions retain causal parent sequences and local-date/timezone metadata. Both undo orders, same-day redo, original anchor restoration, travel, Google undo and transactional rollback pass.

findings.title: R16｜別接続で更新済みでも、古い入力から計算した計画を保存できる
findings.resolution: Read inputs bind SQLite data_version; schedule diff, derived state repairs and calendar signature commit in one guarded read/write transaction. Changed inputs or SQLITE_BUSY_SNAPSHOT retry from fresh inputs; weather discards stale results.

findings.title: R17｜失敗した完了操作が128件に達すると、新しい操作を受け付けない
findings.resolution: Failed durable completion requests retain the original identity and can be retried after storage recovery; protected persistence and real Home/Calendar screen wiring are covered.

findings.title: R18｜Calendarの新規作成応答を失うと、その後の端末編集を上書きし得る
findings.resolution: Personal Calendar persists exact outbound payload and revision before HTTP, recovers only observed receipts and keeps later edits/deletions separate. SQLite restart and uncommitted/third-party cases covered.

findings.title: R19｜個人Tasksの復旧が名前・日付の照合に依存し、変更後に重複や誤対応を生む
findings.resolution: Personal and v2 adapters durably reserve non-idempotent Tasks inserts before HTTP. Stable occurrence markers recover lost responses after rename/move. A missing/uncertain result is held without another POST; other occurrences continue. Recorded links remain fenced across concurrent SQLite connections and reopening; only explicit rejection or confirmed exact-ID deletion reopens creation. Cross-device creation remains R66.

findings.title: R20｜古い一覧の未完了判定で、直前に完了したTasksを削除し得る
findings.resolution: Fresh GET plus strong ETag / exact If-Match gates DELETE; unsafe or missing ETags and HTTP412 preserve mappings. Affected mocks and actual Android Google synthetic-list probe passed, including an intervening completion, stale412, preserved completion, fresh204 and isolated cleanup. Q05 now verified; unrelated shared synchronization remains separately pending.

findings.title: R21｜処理待ちの繰返し例外が先頭26件を占めると、後続の例外を取り込めない
findings.resolution: Persist waiting-instance retry order, alternate bounded batches, keep unresolved state pending, and recover late/cancelled masters. Real SQLite negative tests pass.

findings.title: R22｜鍵更新の再試行が別の鍵を「確定済み」と扱い、端末の復号を止め得る
findings.resolution: Membership idempotence verifies the accepted snapshot and exact owner key envelope/manifest, not only the roster. Distinct keys under the same roster are rejected by the real Cloud test.

findings.title: R23｜古い参加申請を拒否するために、別グループの所属情報を読もうとして失敗する
findings.resolution: Owner rejection reads only the authorized invitation request and leaves another group membership untouched; Rules still deny cross-group membership reads.

findings.title: R24｜参加申請を先頭100件で打ち切り、不正申請に埋もれた正規申請を表示できない
findings.resolution: Validated request pagination and restart cursors cover 99/100/101 rows. Invalid records cannot hide a valid later request or appear as an empty queue; failed page/deletion retains retry state.

findings.title: R25｜復旧証拠の取得が時間切れになると、再試行しても最初からやり直す
findings.resolution: Recovery originals, quarantine and receipt stages survive process/SQLite reopen with no cursor/outbox advancement before complete verification. Both isolated real Cloud tests and local 6-case attacks pass; immutable original protection survives fresh preparation IDs.

findings.title: R26｜履歴の期限削除を一度適用すると、通常のログ圧縮と旧鍵の掃除へ進まなくなる
findings.resolution: Certified retention no longer bypasses ordinary snapshot/key maintenance. Compaction keeps the post-cut protection boundary and ordinary no-retention compaction.

findings.title: R27｜WALの切詰め結果を読まず、削除後処理の未完了を検知できない
findings.resolution: Read TRUNCATE checkpoint outcome, keep a durable local pending marker on BUSY/unknown failure, and retry after the reader releases its WAL snapshot. Two-connection file-backed regression passes.

findings.title: R28｜初回端末設定が既存の設定と衝突すると、通常の端末承認画面へ戻れなくなる
findings.resolution: An explicitly reviewed existing-device pairing reference can retire only a conflicting unaccepted public proposal after verifying server root/account/revision. Protected trust, keys, ciphertext and lost-acceptance recovery remain guarded.

findings.title: R29｜自動同期が時間切れを返しても、端末設定の取得が続き、取得停止の操作が待たされる
findings.resolution: One automatic deadline and abort signal fence device setup, paginated authority reads, key delivery and subsequent SDK operations. A 201-revision regression stops before the next page and permits source disabling.

findings.title: R30｜未来の実施回に付けた完了記録が、予定日を迎える前に履歴削除される
findings.resolution: Adopted specification supersedes personal raw-history deletion: raw facts/actions remain for learning and undo; normal snapshot reads use a one-month window plus future early completions. Shared retention is unchanged.

findings.title: R31｜保存済みの初回予定が、新しく設定した依存順序を無視して残る
findings.resolution: Changing dependencies clears only automatically generated pending first dates of the successor and its transitive descendants. Existing completed anchors, history and unrelated first dates survive; cycles roll back. Repository regressions pass.

findings.title: R32｜契約復帰後に、古い停止処理がウィジェットをロックし直す
findings.resolution: Widget lock/publication share operation ordering and generation guards; a delayed lock read cannot overwrite renewed content. Native output signature follows an actual accepted write.

findings.title: R33｜日付が変わっても、前日の内容を「今日の家事」と表示し続ける
findings.resolution: Snapshots carry their local day/content deadline, iOS publishes a midnight stale entry independently of billing expiry, and both layouts/gesture handlers reject old-day content. OS redraw timing still needs native observation.

findings.title: R34｜Androidのウィジェット完了保存が契約確認より先に行われる
findings.resolution: Android writes only a private durable accepted-input queue off the broadcast thread. Authorized JS rechecks entitlement/account/household/exact occurrence around the common atomic completion, history and Google intent transaction. Exact operation receipt prevents replay after Undo. Kotlin Release compilation passed; physical interaction pending. Android10 physical system-SQLite test found execSQL(PRAGMA busy_timeout) fails; rawQuery correction and stale household/occurrence fencing passed all 45 isolated native assertions. Actual home-screen interaction remains pending. Actual normal v12 launcher row was tapped once: one widget completion fact/input receipt and no pending native input, then normal Home Undo restored0 completed facts without database edits. See widget-v12-android-before/after/after-undo logs. No immediate-render or background execution claim.

findings.title: R35｜ウィジェット公開失敗が上位へ伝わらず、同じ内容の再試行が省略される
findings.resolution: Widget publication failures propagate to the refresh controller while preserving the usable planner; identical cached content retries. Publication and notification failures are isolated.

findings.title: R36｜Google同期後の再公開が、未保存のiOSウィジェット完了操作を消し得る
findings.resolution: iOS durable file journal is independent of timeline props, uses process/file locks plus atomic protected writes, and acknowledges only IDs already committed to SQLite. Native read/write failure retains inputs. A real Swift multiple-process regression passed; Expo Widgets native compilation passed for arm64/x86_64 iOS Simulator; physical checks pending. Normal iOS v12 actual launcher widget tap opens app; real app restart preserves exact completed chore and normal Home Undo restores pending. XCTest15.121s plus UI hierarchy8/1->8/0; no direct DB edit. Not natural background proof.

findings.title: R37｜通知取消しの1件の失敗が、残りの取消しとウィジェット停止まで止める
findings.resolution: Notification cancellations continue after individual failures; widget locking is independent. Failed cleanup retries with bounded delays and on foreground resume, using current subscription/account and shared native output ordering.

findings.title: R38｜再利用された受付IDが保存されず、通信再試行で別の解析が開始される
findings.resolution: Permanent minimal admission receipts bind reused requests to the original job, including force/non-force aliases. A lost reply or expired result cannot create a second paid call for the same admission.

findings.title: R39｜個人家電の再解析が、確認画面を経ずに現在のグループへの共有保存へ進む
findings.resolution: User rejects additional appliance sharing confirmation. Preserve automatic sharing; commit/retry defects remain tracked by R40.

findings.title: R40｜共有保存が確定した後の個人コピー失敗を、共有保存の失敗として返す
findings.resolution: Shared review success is returned independently from personal retention. Pending copy status is visible and existing replica facts/fingerprints allow retry on sync/restart without another review or paid analysis; account changes still reject the returned data.

findings.title: R41｜共有解析の個人コピー後、表示する予定周期と実際の計算周期が食い違う
